title: Multifunctional carbon dots from Polygonatum kingianum and Gastrodia elata: synthesis, characterization, and biomedical applications
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,23845-23861
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03140K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Shengting Zhang, Huili Tao, Xiaodan Zheng, Sha Zhao, Yunlin Wei
Carbon dots (CDs) derived from Polygonatum kingianum (Pk-CDs) and Gastrodia elata (Ge-CDs) were synthesized via a one-step hydrothermal method and characterized using TEM, XPS, and FTIR.
